Every key node has an observable capability statement plus at least one assessment item, and misconceptions and mastery thresholds are present.
Full traceability links each node to S1 goal capabilities, S2 audited evidence, and assessment items, and G3 passes with a deterministic route to S4 only when all graph invariants hold.
